name: Branches
description: Makes each instance the root of a version graph: refs, a primary line and drafts of it, over rows of the kinds the config names, each kind's content a type of the schema document; commits, merges, rebases and reverts; and a release pointer whose history is the release log, its version the release field. The instance's own fields stay outside the graph. The graph lives in the behavior's own tables, and deleting the instance deletes it. With sweep in its config, a schedule discards idle drafts and keeps the graph's storage in bounds.

kinds.description: The graph's kinds, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

type.description: The type of the schema document, besides the instance type, whose fields are the kind's content.

parent.description: Containment, as @graphMember's parent: key is the kind's field, of a UUID scalar, that holds the parent row's entity key, and of is the parent's kind, this one included. Deleting a parent removes its descendants.

order.description: The kind's integer field that orders siblings, as @graphMember's order.

singleton.description: At most one live row of the kind, as @graphMember's singleton.

units.description: A field's conflict unit, as @conflictUnit sets it: atomic (the default), keyed (each top-level key of a JSON object), jsonSchema, or excluded (not content: never merged or hashed).

retentionDays.description: How many days of the kind's history the sweep keeps, as @versioned's retentionDays; all of it when absent.

primary.description: The name of each instance's primary line; main when absent.

snapshotEvery.description: How many commits past the nearest snapshot on its chain a commit is snapshotted at, as @versionGraph's snapshotEvery; 64 when absent.

sweep.description: Turns the sweep schedule on for the schema: each run discards the drafts idle past abandonAfter, then deletes the rows of refs discarded longer ago than discardGrace, prunes each kind's history past its retentionDays and writes missing snapshots.

intervalMs.description: How often it runs, in milliseconds; at least 1000.

discardGrace.description: How long a discarded ref's rows are kept, in milliseconds; seven days when absent.

pruneBatch.description: At most this many history images of each kind pruned per run; no limit when absent.

abandonAfter.description: Discards a draft with no write for this many milliseconds; none when absent.

fields.name: release
fields.description: The number of the instance's latest release: the release pointer's version, which releaseCommit names to move it. Absent before the first release.

operations.name: branch
operations.description: Creates a draft of a ref of the instance, its primary line or another draft, whose rows lay over the ref's head. Without fromRef it branches from the primary line, which an instance created before its schema composed Branches gets then.

fromRef.description: The ref to branch from, by id; the instance's primary line when absent.

name.description: The draft's name, unique among the instance's live refs.

id.description: Its id, a UUID in its canonical form.

name.description: Its name, unique among the instance's live refs.

parent.description: The ref it was branched from; null for the primary line.

base.description: The commit its rows lay over: its parent's head when it was branched or last rebased; null for none.

head.description: Its latest commit; null before its first.

sealed.description: Whether it is sealed, so it takes no more writes.

version.description: Its version, which every write through it names and moves on.

createdAt.description: When it was created, a date-time in UTC.

createdBy.description: The subject of the caller who created it.

updatedAt.description: When it was last written, a date-time in UTC.

updatedBy.description: The subject of the caller who last wrote it.

operations.name: save
operations.description: Writes rows on a draft, at its version: by kind, each upsert row is an entity's whole content and, to replace an entity the draft reads, its entity_key, and is checked against the kind's type; each delete removes an entity from the draft; each unset drops the draft's own row of an entity, so the draft reads it through its base again. A primary line takes no save: work merges into it.

edits.description: The edits by kind: upserts, then deletes, then unsets, kind by kind.

upsert.description: Rows: entity_key and the kind's fields.

delete.description: Entity keys of entities the draft reads.

unset.description: Entity keys of entities the draft has rows of its own for.

resultSchema.description: The draft at its new version, and the rows the upserts stored.

saved.description: By kind, each upsert's row as stored, in edit order.

operations.name: commit
operations.description: Commits a draft at its version: what it composes to that its last commit, or its base, does not. A tagged commit takes the instance's next sequence, and only a tagged commit can be released.

tag.description: Whether the commit takes the instance's next sequence.

resultSchema.description: The draft at its new version, and the commit.

commit.description: The commit written; null when there was nothing to commit.

operations.name: seal
operations.description: Commits a draft at its version when it has changes, and seals it: it takes no more writes.

resultSchema.description: The ref at its new version, and the commit written.

commit.description: The commit written; null when there was nothing to commit.

operations.name: merge
operations.description: Merges a ref's head into another ref of the instance at its version, against the source's base: an entity or a unit changed on one side takes that side, and one changed differently on both is a conflict. With conflicts left after the resolutions it writes nothing and returns them; otherwise it writes the result onto the target and commits it. Merge is the only write a primary line takes.

source.description: The ref to merge from, by id.

target.description: The ref to merge into, by id.

resolutions.description: How to settle conflicts, by kind, entity key and unit path: take a side's value (take) or give one (value, null included).

tag.description: Whether the commit takes the instance's next sequence.

resultSchema.description: The ref merged into, and the commit written; with conflicts nothing was written, the ref is as it was and the commit is null.

commit.description: The commit written; null when there was nothing to commit.

path.description: A JSON Pointer to the unit in the row; empty for an edit against a delete.

base.description: The unit's value at the merge base; absent where it is absent.

ours.description: The unit's value on the side merged into.

theirs.description: The unit's value on the side merged from.

oursAuthor.description: The subject who last wrote our side's row.

theirsAuthor.description: The subject who last wrote their side's row.

operations.name: rebase
operations.description: Moves a draft at its version onto its parent's head: merges the parent's head into the draft, its uncommitted work included, against the draft's base, and commits on the draft. With conflicts left after the resolutions it writes nothing and returns them.

resolutions.description: How to settle conflicts, by kind, entity key and unit path: take a side's value (take) or give one (value, null included).

resultSchema.description: The draft, and the commit written; with conflicts nothing was written.

commit.description: The commit written; null when there was nothing to commit.

path.description: A JSON Pointer to the unit in the row; empty for an edit against a delete.

base.description: The unit's value at the merge base; absent where it is absent.

ours.description: The unit's value on the side merged into.

theirs.description: The unit's value on the side merged from.

oursAuthor.description: The subject who last wrote our side's row.

theirsAuthor.description: The subject who last wrote their side's row.

operations.name: revert
operations.description: Writes the rows that make a draft at its version compose to an earlier commit's tree, and commits them. History is never rewritten.

toCommit.description: The commit of the instance whose tree the draft takes, by id.

resultSchema.description: The ref at its new version, and the commit written.

commit.description: The commit written; null when there was nothing to commit.

operations.name: releaseCommit
operations.description: Points the instance's release pointer at a tagged commit of the instance, fenced by the pointer's version, 0 for the first release: the version graph's release, named so a type can compose Branches with Lease, whose release ends a lease. It writes no rows: a rollback is a releaseCommit of an earlier tagged commit, and the pointer's history is the release log.

version.description: The release pointer's version; 0 for the instance's first release.
Its version, which the next releaseCommit names.

operations.name: discard
operations.description: Discards a draft at its version, which frees its name. The sweep deletes a discarded draft's rows once its grace has passed; its commits stay. The primary line is not discarded.

operations.name: refs
operations.description: Lists the instance's live refs, its primary line first, in the order they were created, one page at a time.

limit.description: At most this many refs; 50 when absent.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

items.description: A ref: the instance's primary line or a draft of it.

id.description: Its id, a UUID in its canonical form.

name.description: Its name, unique among the instance's live refs.

parent.description: The ref it was branched from; null for the primary line.

base.description: The commit its rows lay over: its parent's head when it was branched or last rebased; null for none.

head.description: Its latest commit; null before its first.

sealed.description: Whether it is sealed, so it takes no more writes.

version.description: Its version, which every write through it names and moves on.

createdAt.description: When it was created, a date-time in UTC.

createdBy.description: The subject of the caller who created it.

updatedAt.description: When it was last written, a date-time in UTC.

updatedBy.description: The subject of the caller who last wrote it.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

operations.name: releases
operations.description: Lists the instance's release log, oldest first, one page at a time: each version of its release pointer, the commit it named and who released it when.

limit.description: At most this many releases; 50 when absent.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

version.description: The pointer's version: 1 for the first release.

releasedBy.description: The subject of the caller who released it.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

operations.name: compose
operations.description: Reads a ref's tree: its base commit's tree with the ref's own rows laid over it, uncommitted work included.

resultSchema.description: A tree, its content hash and what was found wrong in it.

tree.description: The tree: by kind, its rows, each with its role, audit and content columns, an actor as a subject.

contentHash.description: The SHA-256 of the tree's content, as lowercase hex.

findings.description: What compose found wrong in the tree; none for a commit's.

resultSchema.description: A tree, its content hash and what was found wrong in it.

tree.description: The tree: by kind, its rows, each with its role, audit and content columns, an actor as a subject.

contentHash.description: The SHA-256 of the tree's content, as lowercase hex.

findings.description: What compose found wrong in the tree; none for a commit's.

operations.name: released
operations.description: Reads the instance's release pointer and the tree of the commit it names. An instance never released has none (not_found).

resultSchema.description: The release pointer and its commit's tree.

version.description: Its version, which the next releaseCommit names.

tree.description: The tree: by kind, its rows, each with its role, audit and content columns, an actor as a subject.

contentHash.description: The SHA-256 of the tree's content, as lowercase hex.

findings.description: What compose found wrong in the tree; none for a commit's.

operations.name: diff
operations.description: Lists the entities the trees of two commits of the instance differ on.

row.description: The later tree's row: its tombstone for a DELETE, when it has one.

operations.name: history
operations.description: Lists the commits a ref wrote, newest first.

id.description: Its id, a UUID in its canonical form.

ref.description: The ref it was written on.

parent.description: The commit before it on its ref's chain; null for none.

sequence.description: Its number among the instance's tagged commits, 1, 2, 3, ...; null for an untagged commit.

contentHash.description: The SHA-256 of its tree's content, as lowercase hex.

createdAt.description: When it was written, a date-time in UTC.

createdBy.description: The subject of the caller who wrote it.

snapshot.description: Whether its full set of row versions is stored, so a read of its tree stops there.

vetoes.description: A write through a ref, or a releaseCommit, at a version the ref or the release pointer has moved past.
branch to a name another live ref of the instance has.
A write through a sealed ref.
save, commit, seal or revert on a primary line, which takes writes only from merge.
commit of a draft that composes to the tree of its last commit, or of its base.
save that deletes an entity the draft does not read, or unsets a row the draft does not have.
A commit whose tree breaks the graph's rules (an absent parent, a second singleton, a parent cycle, an order out of range), with the findings in details.
merge of a ref into itself.
rebase of a primary line, which has no parent to rebase onto.
releaseCommit of a commit that is not tagged.
A read of a commit's tree that would walk more commits than the engine's ceiling.
discard of the instance's primary line, which its drafts branch from and merge into.
